liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Dig A Little Deeper In The Well**: rare: 12 archived performances [5]
- **Cruising Timber**: back after 166 archived shows (1196 days); rare: 3 archived performances [5]
- **These Old Blues**: back after 82 archived shows (426 days) [5]
- **Sweet Revenge**: back after 115 archived shows (576 days); rare: 4 archived performances [5]
- **Pickin’ Up The Pieces**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [5]
- **Standing In The Need Of Prayer**: rare: 14 archived performances [5]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2023-06-09.mk41.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 30 songs; 158 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Vocals came through weakly in this room, while the instruments were presented very well; The recording conveys the room's ambiance and the crowd's energy [4]
- **billystrings2023-06-09.dpa4061.mk41.flac16**: source not stated; 30 songs; 158 min [2]
- **billystrings2023-06-09.dpa4021.flac16**: source not stated; 30 songs; 158 min [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2023-06-09.mk41.flac16**: taped by Steve Brothers and djphrayz; transferred by djphrayz; source: MK41s (FOH/ROC/XY90]/~9.5') > EAA-PSP2 > MP6ii (24/96) [1]. Also: MK41 mics placed at front of house, XY90 pattern, about 9.5 feet up, into EAA-PSP2 preamp and MP6ii recorder at 24/96; Recorded by Steve Brothers and djphrayz; djphrayz processed in Reaper, encoded to FLAC with dBpoweramp, tagged, and posted it [1]
- **billystrings2023-06-09.dpa4061.mk41.flac16**: taped by Steve Brothers and djphrayz; transferred by djphrayz; source: DPA4061 + MK41 [2]. Also: DPA4061 signal ran through a DAD6001 and MP10ii into an MP6ii at 24/96; the MK41 path used EAA-PSP2; The DPA4061 feed was patched from djphrayz, who secured the taping spot and clamp space; Steve Brothers and djphrayz recorded [2]
- **billystrings2023-06-09.dpa4021.flac16**: taped by Steve Brothers and djphrayz; transferred by djphrayz; source: DPA4021s (FOH/ROC/DIN]/~9.5') > EAA-PSP2 > MP6ii [3]. Also: DPA4021 mics in DIN pattern at front of house, about 9.5 feet up, into EAA-PSP2 and MP6ii at 24/96; Recorded by Steve Brothers and djphrayz; processed in Reaper, encoded with dBpoweramp, tagged and posted by djphrayz [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by @swaycout: [Billy Strings June 9 2023 Chaifetz Arena St. Louis Mo Poster](https://swaycout.com/billy-strings-june-9-2023-chaifetz-arena-st-louis-mo-poster/) [6]
- Poster by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings 2023-06-09 Chaifetz Arena Regular - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/merch/2023-06-09-chaifetz-arena-regular/) [7]
- Fan art by Caitlin Mattisson: [Billy Strings - June 9, 2023- Chaifetz Arena, St. Louis, MO. Artwork by Caitlin Mattisson](https://caitlinmattissonart.bigcartel.com/product/billy-strings-june-9-2023-chaifetz-arena-st-louis-mo-artwork-by-caitlin-mattisson) [8]
- Fan art by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings 2023-06-09 Chaifetz Arena Regular - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/merch/2023-06-09-chaifetz-arena-regular/) [9]
- Fan art by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings 2023-06-09 Chaifetz Arena Regular - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/merch/2023-06-09-chaifetz-arena-regular/) [10]
